newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Telecom hits new year low.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Telecom hits new year low.

text.p: Singapore Telecom Ltd (SingTel) shares hit a new 1997 low of Singapore $2.94 in early trading on Thursday.
Dealers said the fall was due to a generally poor stock market sentiment as well as the fact that SingTel lost its monopoly on the mobile phone and pager markets on Tuesday.
At 0049 GMT, the stock was down five cents to S$2.94. Volume was a moderate 341,000 units.
A dealer with a local broking firm said the selling was also triggered by news of SingTel cutting its cellular rates to match those of its rival.
"They have to undercut to be competitive and it will affect their margins," she said.
